title: Spending the $1.6 billion federal recovery grant
summary: As of late September 2026, the county is spending a $1.6 billion HUD disaster recovery grant, with $1.39 billion obligated and spending projected through 2031. Staff report 577 housing units completed, 400 under construction and 597 in progress, with 83 shopping letters issued in the first-time homebuyer program. Rising infrastructure costs are a key risk, and multifamily rebuilds must give fire survivors priority to move back.

timeline.text: The County's Hoʻokumu Hou First-Time Homebuyer program issued its 100th shopping letter to displaced fire survivors.

source.publisher: County of Maui Office of Recovery
source.quote: Eighteen households displaced by the 2023 Maui Wildfires received their home-shopping letters today through the County of Maui’s Hoʻokumu Hou First-Time Homebuyer Opportunity Program, bringing the total issued through the program to 100.

timeline.text: A speaker said the federal government gave 1.6 billion dollars for housing and rebuilding.
The chair deferred the disaster recovery item.
